claims.text: OpenAI released GPT-5.2-Codex as a coding model aimed at long-horizon reasoning and large-scale code transformation.

overrides.why_this_special: Closes the half-year with continued specialization of the frontier family for agentic coding.

claims.text: OpenAI announced co-founding the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation and donating AGENTS.md.

limitations: Foundation creation and artifact donation are factual; ecosystem adoption and lasting standardization impact are not established by the announcement.
overrides.why_this_special: Potential signal that agent tooling was beginning to seek shared interoperability conventions, but adoption impact was not established within the coverage window.

artifact.canonical_name: Qwen / Alibaba Model Studio H2 2025 lifecycle

claims.text: Alibaba Model Studio recorded Qwen3-Coder on July 22 as a Qwen3-based code model with agent/tool-calling and environment-interaction capabilities.
The lifecycle page shows continued H2 expansion across long-context/reasoning, coder, vision/omni, speech, and image-generation model families rather than a single-model cadence.
Availability entries distinguish regions and dated snapshots, so model identity and deployment availability must remain separate from upstream/open-weight announcements.

limitations: The Model Studio page is a living deployment catalog; it mixes release, snapshot, regional availability, and later global availability entries. Architecture must not collapse those into one upstream model release date.
overrides.why_this_special: Provides a non-US model/API lifecycle showing rapid family proliferation across coding, multimodality, speech, and generation.

artifact.canonical_name: Claude 4.5 model and agent platform sequence

claims.text: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 4.5 on September 29 together with Claude Code upgrades and the Claude Agent SDK.
Anthropic released Claude Haiku 4.5 on October 15 and Claude Opus 4.5 on November 24, each with API availability.
Anthropic's H2 sequence tied model releases to coding, computer-use, context/memory, and agent-building surfaces.

limitations: The preserved newsroom snapshot is a living paginated index and its first HTML page emphasized 2026 entries; item-level official Anthropic pages were followed during interactive verification to reconstruct H2 2025 chronology.
overrides.why_this_special: Provides a cross-vendor comparison showing the same coupling of frontier models, coding agents, tool use, and context-management infrastructure.

claims.text: DeepSeek's API changelog records V3.1 on August 21, V3.1-Terminus on September 22, V3.2-Exp on September 29, and V3.2 on December 1.
The changelog maps deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner to non-thinking and thinking modes of these model versions.
V3.2-Speciale was exposed through a temporary endpoint with no tool calls and an explicit expiration, so it is not equivalent to the stable V3.2 service.

limitations: These dates establish DeepSeek API service transitions; upstream training/checkpoint publication dates must not be inferred when not stated.
overrides.why_this_special: Shows a compressed non-US API/model lifecycle and the growing importance of reasoning-mode/tool-use distinctions in deployment identity.

artifact.canonical_name: Google DeepMind H2 world-model, robotics, and agent research

claims.text: Google DeepMind announced Genie 3 on August 5 as a real-time interactive world model.

Google DeepMind announced Gemini Robotics 1.5 and Robotics-ER 1.5 on September 25, pairing physical action with embodied reasoning/tool use; Robotics-ER 1.5 was made available via the Gemini API while Robotics 1.5 was limited to select partners.
SIMA 2 on November 13 integrated Gemini reasoning into a 3D-world agent, and Gemini 3 followed on November 18 as a broader frontier-model release.

limitations: The preserved DeepMind index snapshot is paginated and its first page is not a complete H2 archive; item-level first-party pages were used during interactive verification.
Research prototypes, limited-partner robotics access, and generally available API models must remain distinct.
overrides.why_this_special: Extends the half-year beyond text/code agents into interactive worlds and physical action, useful for testing whether 'action spaces' broadened across layers.

claims.text: The Gemini API changelog records a dense H2 sequence spanning asynchronous batch processing, embedding, video, image, native audio, robotics, computer use, Gemini 3, a unified Interactions API, and a Deep Research agent.
The changelog explicitly distinguishes preview, general availability, deprecation, and shutdown events; those states are part of the technical chronology.
Gemini 3 Pro Preview entered the API on November 18, while Gemini 3 Flash Preview followed on December 17.

limitations: The changelog is a service/API chronology, not an upstream research-release chronology; preview-to-GA and shutdown events should not be merged with initial model announcements.
overrides.why_this_special: A high-resolution API chronology demonstrating that model progress and agent/multimodal capabilities were arriving as a stream of independently versioned service surfaces.

claims.text: Kimi's official platform records Kimi K2 on July 11, a September 5 update with stronger coding/context behavior, and Kimi K2 Thinking on November 6.
K2 Thinking was positioned as a thinking agent model that interleaves reasoning and tool use.

limitations: The hash-pinned Kimi Code 'What's New' page is a living product document whose current rendered history begins much later; item chronology was cross-checked against Kimi's first-party platform blog/changelog during interactive verification.
overrides.why_this_special: Adds an open-model agentic sequence centered on coding, tool calling, and test-time reasoning outside the US vendor set.

claims.text: MiniMax's first-party release notes record MiniMax M2 on October 27 as an agent-oriented model, Hailuo 2.3/2.3-Fast video models on October 28, and MiniMax M2.1 on December 22.
Hailuo 2.3 was rolled out across the Hailuo product and Open Platform API, pairing model improvements with a Media Agent workflow.

limitations: The preserved `minimax.io/news` landing snapshot is client-rendered and sparse; item-level first-party MiniMax release notes/news were used during interactive verification.
overrides.why_this_special: Provides a compact example of agentic text models and multimodal/video systems advancing in parallel within one vendor.

artifact.canonical_name: Mistral H2 2025 model and agent stack

claims.text: Mistral's official news index records a July sequence across Devstral coding, Voxtral speech, Le Chat research, and Codestral, followed by MCP/connectors/memory in September.
The index records Mistral AI Studio on October 24, Mistral 3 on December 2, and Devstral 2 with Mistral Vibe CLI on December 9.

limitations: The news index reliably establishes publication chronology and titles; detailed benchmark/license claims require item-level pages and should remain vendor-attributed if used in drafting.
overrides.why_this_special: Shows open-model/coding/speech and product-agent layers evolving together, strengthening the cross-vendor stack thesis.
